spec.doc: Parcel Post and Express Post - Label & Barcode Specification v1.4

rules.title: AI 00 SSCC decoded
rules.description: The linear barcode must contain FNC1 + AI 00 + the 18-digit SSCC (20 digits including AI 00) and nothing else.

messages.fail: SSCC assessment was selected, but no valid AI 00 SSCC barcode was decoded.

rules.title: SSCC check digit
rules.description: The final SSCC digit must satisfy the GS1 mod-10 check digit algorithm.

messages.pass: All decoded SSCC barcodes have valid mod-10 check digits.
messages.fail: One or more decoded SSCC values failed the mod-10 check digit.
messages.skipped: No SSCC barcode was decoded from the linear symbol, so the check digit could not be assessed.

rules.title: GS1-128 FNC1 in first position
rules.description: A GS1-128 SSCC barcode starts with FNC1. Scanners report this as the code ]C1.

messages.pass: Scanner reported symbology identifier ]C1: FNC1 is encoded in the first position, so the symbol is a conforming GS1-128 SSCC barcode.
messages.fail: The reported symbology identifier indicates the symbol does NOT start with FNC1 - it decodes as plain Code 128, not GS1-128. See the identifier in the evidence.
messages.missing: The decoder did not report an ISO/IEC 15424 symbology identifier, so FNC1-in-first-position could not be verified digitally. Confirm the symbol was generated as GS1-128 (Code 128 with a leading FNC1), not plain Code 128.

rules.title: SSCC is in the merchant's reserved range
rules.description: The SSCC must sit inside a range from the merchant profile, and in the range for the printed product. Runs only when SSCC ranges are entered.

rules.title: SSCC uses a GS1 Australia prefix
rules.description: Australian merchants' SSCCs usually start with a GS1 Australia prefix (93). Another prefix is allowed, so this is a note. Skipped when the profile has SSCC ranges.
rules.expectedText: Starts with a GS1 Australia prefix (93)

messages.pass: SSCC {actual} uses a GS1 Australia company prefix.
messages.fail: SSCC {actual} doesn't use a GS1 Australia prefix (93). That's allowed, but confirm it's the merchant's registered prefix.

rules.title: DataMatrix repeats the linear SSCC
rules.description: The DataMatrix must carry the same SSCC as the linear barcode.

messages.pass: The DataMatrix carries the same SSCC as the linear barcode.
messages.fail: The DataMatrix article ({actual}) does not equal the SSCC decoded from the linear barcode.
messages.missing: The DataMatrix has no SSCC in the AI 91 position, so it can't be compared with the linear SSCC.
messages.skipped: No valid linear SSCC was decoded, so the DataMatrix SSCC could not be cross-checked against it.

rules.title: DataMatrix retains the Australia Post GTIN prefix
rules.description: On SSCC labels the GS1 DataMatrix must still open with AI 01 + the Australia Post GTIN 99312650999998 before the AI 91 article component.

messages.pass: The DataMatrix opens with AI 01 and the Australia Post GTIN.
messages.fail: The DataMatrix does not open with AI 01 + the Australia Post GTIN 99312650999998.

rules.title: Visible article ID matches barcode
rules.description: The printed article ID (on SSCC labels, the 20-digit AI 00 + SSCC) must match the barcode, ignoring spaces. Overlays and watermarks can throw off text reading.

messages.pass: Visible article identifier matches the decoded barcode article.
messages.fail: Visible article identifier does not match the decoded barcode article. Check it on the label. Overlays and watermarks can throw off text reading.

rules.title: SSCC not permitted on returns labels
rules.description: Returns labels can't use SSCC barcodes. They need the standard barcode.

messages.pass: The label header does not read as a returns label.
messages.fail: The label header reads as a returns label ({actual}); SSCC barcodes cannot be used for eParcel Returns. Confirm the label type and numbering.
messages.skipped: The label header couldn't be read, so the returns check couldn't run.

rules.title: SSCC product checks skipped
rules.description: SSCC numbering cannot embed product or service codes, so those barcode-level checks do not apply. Delivery conditions come from the electronic order data.

messages.pass: SSCC labels don't carry product or service codes, so those checks are skipped.
